Before a defense against an adjacent enemy, gain 1 Boon to the defense. After the attack resolves, if the defense was Strong and the attacker is within your reach, make a Basic Melee attack against that attacker. This counterattack is part of the Reaction and does not use your Main Action.

None.

Repeatable; normal action economy applies.
Type
Signature
